metadata.description: Best-practice Agent Skills covering the whole software lifecycle, for any product and any stack

plugins.name: dev-lifecycle
plugins.description: Stack-agnostic skills for the lifecycle phases upstream collections do not cover: requirements, architecture decisions, API contracts, threat modeling, test strategy, refactoring, data migrations, performance, security review, dependency upgrades, observability, CI health, release, incident response, postmortems, and accessibility

plugins.name: superpowers
plugins.description: Jesse Vincent's agentic development methodology: brainstorming, planning, TDD, systematic debugging, code review, and branch integration. Installed under the name 'superpowers' so its internal superpowers:<skill> references resolve.

plugins.name: example-skills
plugins.description: The development-relevant subset of Anthropic's example skills: skill authoring, MCP server construction, Playwright-driven web app testing, and frontend visual design. Apache-2.0 skills only; the source-available document skills are deliberately excluded.
